<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SurakshaOne — One Subscription. Complete Protection.</title>
<meta name="description" content="One membership covering health and nutrition, digital safety, travel, money and your parents. Five protections, one subscription, one dashboard.">
<meta property="og:title" content="SurakshaOne — One Subscription. Complete Protection.">
<meta property="og:description" content="Five everyday protections in one membership. Health and nutrition, digital safety, travel, money and parent care.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64," type="image/png">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#111826; --ink-2:#1a2744; --ink-soft:#666c78; --mute:#8b919c;
    --teal-deep:#2c5fdd; --teal:#00b0d6; --purple:#3738ac; --coral:#e7000b; --blue:#2c5fdd;
    --brand-blue:#2c5fdd; --brand-blue-deep:#3738ac; --brand-cyan:#00b0d6; --brand-green:#24c27d;
    --paper:#ffffff; --paper-2:#f2f5fb; --white:#fff;
    --line:#e5e8ed; --line-2:rgba(17,24,38,.08);
    --sh-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(44,95,221,.06);
    --sh:0 8px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.10);
    --sh-lg:0 24px 60px rgba(44,95,221,.14);
    --r:20px; --maxw:1180px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
  body{margin:0;font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;margin:0;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:700}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block}
  button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
  section{padding:92px 0}
  @media (max-width:720px){section{padding:60px 0}}
  .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
  a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}

  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:18px}
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue),var(--brand-cyan))}
  .sec-head{max-width:660px;margin-bottom:50px}
  .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px);font-weight:600}
  .sec-head p{margin-top:14px;font-size:16.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}

  .btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s,background .15s}
  .btn-p{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  .btn-p:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(44,95,221,.34);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .btn-g{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
  .btn-g:hover{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper-2)}

  /* NAV */
  header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .navbar{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:13px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .brand img{height:34px;width:auto}
  .brand-name{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:19px}
  .brand-name b{color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;margin-left:auto}
  .nav-links > a,.has-dd > a{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .nav-links > a:hover,.has-dd > a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
  .nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-left:28px}
  .nav-cta{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  .nav-cta:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:none;padding:6px}
  .nav-toggle span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);margin:5px 0;border-radius:2px}
  .has-dd{position:relative}
  .dd{position:absolute;top:100%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:8px;width:290px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.15s}
  .has-dd:hover .dd,.has-dd:focus-within .dd{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(2px)}
  .dd a{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
  .dd a:hover{background:var(--paper-2)}
  .dd a i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:6px}
  .dd a em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:1px}
  @media (max-width:960px){
    .nav-links{position:fixed;inset:60px 0 auto 0;background:#fff;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:0;padding:8px 28px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transform:translateY(-150%);transition:transform .25s;box-shadow:var(--sh);max-height:calc(100vh - 60px);overflow-y:auto;margin-left:0}
    .nav-links.open{transform:translateY(0)}
    .nav-links > a,.has-dd{width:100%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
    .nav-links > a{padding:13px 0}
    .has-dd > a{display:block;padding:13px 0}
    .dd{position:static;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;box-shadow:none;border:none;width:100%;display:none;padding:0 0 8px 10px;left:auto}
    .dd a{padding:9px 8px}
    .has-dd:hover .dd,.has-dd:focus-within .dd{transform:none;position:static}
    .has-dd.open .dd{display:block}
    .nav-toggle{display:block}
    .nav-cta{display:none}
  }
  @media (max-width:400px){.brand-name{font-size:16.5px}}

  /* HERO */
  .hero{padding:80px 0 56px}
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:52px;align-items:center}
  @media (max-width:960px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,58px);font-weight:600}
  .hero h1 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 45%,var(--brand-cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
  .hero .sub{margin-top:22px;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:500px}
  .hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:13px;margin-top:32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .hero-fine{margin-top:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
  .orbit{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;max-width:450px;margin:0 auto}
  .ring{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px dashed var(--line)}
  .ring.r2{inset:40px;border-style:dotted}
  .core{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:38%;height:38%;border-radius:0;background:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:none;overflow:visible;padding:0}
  .core img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.22))}
  .onode{position:absolute;width:17%;height:17%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);animation:fl 6s ease-in-out infinite}
  .onode svg{width:46%;height:46%}
  @keyframes fl{0%,100%{margin-top:0}50%{margin-top:-7px}}
  .olabel{position:absolute;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);background:#fff;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);white-space:nowrap}
  @media (max-width:960px){
    .orbit{max-width:330px}
    .olabel{display:block;font-size:10px;padding:2px 7px;line-height:1.35;z-index:2}
    .olabel:nth-of-type(1){left:50%!important;top:-4%!important;transform:translate(-50%,-100%)!important}
    .olabel:nth-of-type(2){left:auto!important;right:0!important;top:28.7%!important;transform:translate(0,calc(-100% - 10px))!important}
    .olabel:nth-of-type(3){left:auto!important;right:0!important;top:75.1%!important;transform:translate(0,calc(-100% - 10px))!important}
    .olabel:nth-of-type(4){left:0!important;top:75.1%!important;transform:translate(0,calc(-100% - 10px))!important}
    .olabel:nth-of-type(5){left:0!important;top:28.7%!important;transform:translate(0,calc(-100% - 10px))!important}
  }

  /* STRIPE */
  .stripe{background:var(--brand-blue-deep);color:#fff;padding:38px 0}
  .stripe .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:26px}
  .stripe .it{flex:1 1 210px}
  .stripe .k{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:23px}
  .stripe .d{font-size:12.8px;color:#B9C3D6;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5}
  .stripe .src{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;color:#7C8FAB}
  @media (max-width:720px){
    .stripe{padding:28px 0 30px}
    .stripe .wrap{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
      gap:0;
      max-width:520px;
      margin:0 auto;
    }
    .stripe .it{
      flex:none;
      text-align:center;
      padding:22px 14px;
    }
    .stripe .it:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
    .stripe .it:nth-child(odd){border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
    .stripe .k{font-size:clamp(20px,5.5vw,24px);letter-spacing:-.02em}
    .stripe .d{font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;max-width:15.5em;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
    .stripe .src{font-size:10px;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.4}
  }

  /* WHY */
  .why-band{background:var(--paper-2);border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .g4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
  @media (max-width:900px){.g4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media (max-width:520px){.g4{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .wcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:24px 20px}
  .wcard .n{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12px;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
  .wcard h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
  .wcard p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0}

  /* MODULES */
  .mods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
  @media (max-width:980px){.mods{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media (max-width:620px){.mods{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .mcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:26px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s}
  .mcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .mic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px}
  .mic svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke-width:1.8;fill:none}
  .mcard h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:7px}
  .mcard .tag{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px}
  .mcard ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 20px;padding:0;flex:1}
  .mcard li{font-size:13.8px;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:6px 0 6px 19px;position:relative}
  .mcard li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:14px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal)}
  .mfoot{padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
  .i-well{background:#eaf0ff}.i-well svg{stroke:var(--teal-deep)}
  .i-cyber{background:#E7ECFB}.i-cyber svg{stroke:var(--blue)}
  .i-travel{background:#FCEEE9}.i-travel svg{stroke:var(--coral)}
  .i-life{background:#EFE7F7}.i-life svg{stroke:var(--purple)}
  .i-parent{background:#FDF0E3}.i-parent svg{stroke:#B87333}

  /* DEEP DIVE */
  .dd-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:center;padding:74px 0}
  .dd-row:not(:last-child){border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .dd-row.rev{direction:rtl}.dd-row.rev>*{direction:ltr}
  @media (max-width:900px){.dd-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;padding:50px 0}.dd-row.rev{direction:ltr}}
  .dd-eb{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:13px;display:block}
  .dd-row h3{font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,32px);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:15px}
  .dd-row > div > p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15.5px}
  .dlist{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:22px 0 0}
  .dlist li{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:11px 0;font-size:14.5px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .dlist li:first-child{border-top:none}
  .dlist .lbl{font-weight:600;min-width:158px;flex-shrink:0}
  .dlist .val{color:var(--ink-soft)}

  /* signature cards */
  .rep{background:#1a2744;border-radius:16px;padding:26px;color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh-lg);font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif}
  .rep-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-bottom:15px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
  .rep-h .t{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8FA3C0}
  .rep-h .s{font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(225,87,63,.18);color:#FF9C86}
  .rep-r{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
  .rep-r:last-of-type{border-bottom:none}
  .rep-r .k{font-size:13px;color:#C6D3E6}
  .rep-r .v{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap}
  .v.ex{background:rgba(225,87,63,.18);color:#FF9C86}
  .v.ok{background:rgba(36,194,125,.16);color:var(--brand-green)}
  .rep-a{margin-top:15px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(44,95,221,.08);border:1px solid rgba(44,95,221,.22);font-family:'Inter';font-size:13px;color:var(--brand-blue-deep);line-height:1.55}
  .rep-a b{color:#7dd3fc}
  .rep-n{font-size:11.5px;color:#7C8FAB;margin-top:14px;font-family:'Inter'}

  .card-w{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .ready-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end}
  .ready-h .l{font-family:'Inter';font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
  .ready-s{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:34px;color:var(--purple);line-height:1}
  .ready-s span{font-size:15px;color:var(--mute);font-weight:500}
  .bar{height:7px;border-radius:100px;background:var(--paper-2);overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0 18px}
  .bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--teal))}
  .crow{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .crow .c{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
  .c.done{background:#eaf0ff;color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .c.todo{background:#FCEEE9;color:var(--coral)}
  .crow .l2{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
  .crow .d2{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px}
  .card-note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:15px}

  .chat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .bub{max-width:88%;padding:12px 15px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13.8px;margin-bottom:11px;line-height:1.5}
  .bub.in{background:var(--paper-2);border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
  .bub.out{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;margin-left:auto;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
  .bub .who{display:block;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;opacity:.65}
  .verdict{margin-top:6px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:11px;background:#FCEEE9;border:1px solid rgba(225,87,63,.28);font-size:13.5px;color:#8E2E1A;line-height:1.55}
  .verdict b{color:var(--coral)}

  .steps-v{display:grid;gap:0}
  .stepv{display:flex;gap:15px;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .stepv:first-child{border-top:none}
  .stepv .sn{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:#fff;background:var(--brand-blue);width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
  .stepv.hl .sn{background:var(--teal-deep)}
  .stepv h4{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px}
  .stepv p{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0}

  .tcats{display:grid;gap:13px}
  .tcat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px}
  .tcat .cn{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--coral);margin-bottom:8px}
  .tcat .sv{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
  .tcat .ds{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .tcat .sv:not(:first-of-type){margin-top:11px}

  /* SEGMENTS */
  #who .sec-head{margin-bottom:36px}
  .stabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:0 0 40px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .stab{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .stab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--brand-blue)}
  .spanel{display:none}
  .spanel.active{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.08fr);gap:28px 72px;align-items:center}
  @media (max-width:840px){.spanel.active{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}.stabs{margin-bottom:28px}}
  .spanel > div{max-width:440px}
  .spanel h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,29px);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.18}
  .spanel > div > p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
  .spts{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .spts li{background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;padding:18px 4px 18px 0}
  .spts strong{display:block;font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
  .spts span{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.5}

  /* APP */
  .app-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:54px;align-items:center}
  @media (max-width:900px){.app-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}}
  .phone{max-width:288px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--ink);border-radius:32px;padding:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh-lg)}
  .pscr{background:var(--paper);border-radius:24px;padding:17px 13px}
  .ptop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:15px}
  .ptop .hi{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
  .ptop .dot{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink),var(--teal))}
  .pc{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:8px}
  .pc .pl{font-size:10px;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:700}
  .pc .pv{font-size:13.3px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
  .pc .pm{font-size:11.3px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px}
  .pcta{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;margin-top:4px}
  .afeats{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0;display:grid;gap:13px}
  .afeats li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .afeats .ic{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px;background:#eaf0ff;color:var(--teal-deep);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-top:1px}
  .afeats b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
  .dl-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;justify-content:center}
  .store-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));color:#fff;min-width:200px;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  .store-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .store-btn span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.15;text-align:left}
  .store-btn small{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;opacity:.75}
  .store-btn strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}

  /* TRUST */
  .trust{background:var(--brand-blue-deep);color:#fff}
  .trust h2,.trust .sec-head h2{color:#fff}
  .trust .sec-head p{color:#B9C3D6}
  .g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
  @media (max-width:840px){.g3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .tcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:var(--r);padding:24px 22px}
  .tcard .ic{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(44,95,221,.16);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:15px}
  .tcard .ic svg{width:19px;height:19px;stroke:#7dd3fc;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8}
  .tcard h4{color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
  .tcard p{font-size:13.4px;color:#B9C3D6;margin:0}

  /* PRICING */
  .pband{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper),var(--paper-2));border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .toggle{display:inline-flex;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:100px;padding:4px;margin:0 auto 36px;gap:2px}
  .toggle button{padding:9px 22px;border-radius:100px;border:none;background:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .toggle button.on{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff}
  .toggle .save{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal-deep);margin-left:6px}
  .toggle button.on .save{color:#7dd3fc}
  .plans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-bottom:44px}
  @media (max-width:940px){.plans{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:460px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}}
  .plan{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative}
  .plan.best{border:2px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--sh-lg)}
  .plan .flag{position:absolute;top:-12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap}
  .plan h4{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px}
  .plan .who{font-size:13.2px;color:var(--ink-soft);min-height:38px}
  .plan .amt{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:38px;margin:14px 0 2px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
  .plan .amt small{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mute)}
  .plan .per{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:20px}
  .plan ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 22px;flex:1}
  .plan li{font-size:13.6px;padding:7px 0 7px 24px;position:relative;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .plan li::before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px}
  .plan li.off{color:var(--mute)}
  .plan li.off::before{content:"—";color:#c7ccd6}
  .plan .btn{width:100%;text-align:center}
  .plan-note{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:-24px;margin-bottom:44px}

  .cmp-block{margin-top:8px}
  .cmp-block .cmp-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:28px}
  .cmp-block .cmp-head h3{font-family:'Inter';font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,32px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 10px}
  .cmp-block .cmp-head p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15.5px;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}
  .cmp-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
  table.cmp{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:920px}
  table.cmp th,table.cmp td{padding:16px 14px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);font-size:14px;vertical-align:middle}
  table.cmp thead th{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:14px;background:#fff;padding-top:36px;padding-bottom:22px;position:relative}
  table.cmp thead th .pname{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
  table.cmp thead th .pprice{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  table.cmp thead th.hl{background:rgba(44,95,221,.06)}
  table.cmp thead th.hl .pname{color:var(--blue)}
  table.cmp .best-pill{position:absolute;top:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap}
  table.cmp td.f{color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:500;min-width:180px}
  table.cmp td.c,table.cmp th.c{text-align:center}
  table.cmp td.hl,table.cmp tbody td.hl{background:rgba(44,95,221,.04)}
  table.cmp .yes{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#E6F7EF;color:#1FAE6C;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
  table.cmp .no{color:#c7ccd6;font-size:18px;font-weight:400;line-height:1}
  table.cmp .addon{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  table.cmp tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
  table.cmp .cta-row td{padding:22px 14px 28px;border-bottom:none}
  table.cmp .cta-row .btn{min-width:96px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:13.5px}
  table.cmp .cta-row .btn-p{box-shadow:none}
  .cmp-mobile{display:none}
  @media (max-width:820px){
    .cmp-wrap{display:none}
    .cmp-mobile{display:grid;gap:12px}
    .cmp-mcard{
      border:1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius:16px;
      background:#fff;
      padding:18px 16px 16px;
      box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);
    }
    .cmp-mcard.hl{
      border-color:rgba(44,95,221,.35);
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(44,95,221,.06),#fff 42%);
    }
    .cmp-mcard .mtop{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
    .cmp-mcard .pname{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.01em}
    .cmp-mcard .pprice{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:3px}
    .cmp-mcard .best-pill{
      flex-shrink:0;
      background:var(--blue);
      color:#fff;
      font-size:10px;
      font-weight:700;
      letter-spacing:.06em;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      padding:4px 10px;
      border-radius:100px;
      white-space:nowrap;
      margin-top:2px;
    }
    .cmp-mcard .feats{list-style:none;margin:0 0 14px;padding:0;display:grid;gap:7px}
    .cmp-mcard .feats li{
      display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;
      font-size:13.2px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.4;
    }
    .cmp-mcard .feats .yes{
      width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;
      background:#E6F7EF;color:#1FAE6C;
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      font-size:11px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;
    }
    .cmp-mcard .btn{width:100%;text-align:center;box-sizing:border-box;padding:11px 16px;font-size:13.5px}
    .cmp-mcard .btn-p{box-shadow:none}
  }
  .yes{color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:700}
  .no{color:#c7ccd6}
  .ad{font-size:12px;color:var(--purple);font-weight:600}

  /* VALUE */
  .val-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}
  @media (max-width:900px){.val-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}}
  .vrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line-2);font-size:14.3px}
  .vrow .vl{color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .vrow .vv{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
  .vtot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:16px 0 0;font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
  .vtot .vv{font-family:'Inter';color:var(--coral)}
  .vours{margin-top:18px;padding:18px 20px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--brand-blue-deep);color:#fff;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px}
  .vours .vl{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
  .vours .vv{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:24px;color:#7dd3fc}

  /* FAQ */
  .faq{max-width:830px;margin:0 auto}
  .fitem{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .fq{width:100%;background:none;border:none;text-align:left;padding:21px 40px 21px 0;font-family:'Inter';font-size:16.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);position:relative;display:block}
  .fq::after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:22px;font-weight:400;color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .fitem.open .fq::after{content:"−"}
  .fa{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .28s ease}
  .fitem.open .fa{max-height:460px}
  .fa p{padding:0 30px 21px 0;margin:0;font-size:14.8px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.65}

  /* EMPLOYERS */
  .pbox{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:40px 36px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
  @media (max-width:840px){.pbox{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;padding:30px 24px}}
  .pbox h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,28px);margin-bottom:12px}
  .pbox > div > p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15px;margin:0 0 18px}
  .pstats{display:flex;gap:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .pstats .k{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:19px;color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .pstats .d{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  form.f{display:grid;gap:10px}
  form.f input,form.f select{padding:12px 15px;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font-family:'Inter';font-size:14px;background:var(--paper);width:100%}
  form.f input:focus,form.f select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--teal);background:#fff}
  form.f button{padding:13px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;border:none;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  form.f button:hover{background:var(--teal-deep)}
  .fmsg{font-size:13px;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:500;min-height:16px}

  /* FINAL */
  .final{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),#2c5fdd 55%,var(--brand-cyan) 130%);border-radius:24px;padding:62px 44px;text-align:center;color:#fff;margin:0 28px}
  .final h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,38px);margin-bottom:13px}
  .final p{color:#C9D3E2;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:28px}
  .final .btn-p{background:#fff;color:var(--brand-blue);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:none}
  .final .btn-g{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
  .final .btn-g:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:#fff;color:#fff}
  .final .cta-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
  .final .fine{margin-top:17px;font-size:12.5px;color:#9FB0C7}

  /* FOOTER */
  footer{padding:62px 0 30px}
  .fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr repeat(4,1fr);gap:30px;padding-bottom:38px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  @media (max-width:840px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media (max-width:520px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .fbrand img{height:30px;margin-bottom:13px}
  .fbrand p{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:265px}
  .fcol h5{font-size:12.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:13px;font-weight:600}
  .fcol a{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:5px 0}
  .fcol a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
  .fbot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding-top:24px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mute)}
  .ftrust{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 12px;max-width:52rem;line-height:1.5}
  .flegal{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);max-width:700px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:16px}

  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1),transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1)}
  .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard, .mods.reveal.in .mcard, .g3.reveal.in .tcard, .plans.reveal.in .plan{
    animation:pop-in .55s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.1) backwards;
  }
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(1),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(1),.g3.reveal.in .tcard:nth-child(1),.plans.reveal.in .plan:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.03s}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(2),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(2),.g3.reveal.in .tcard:nth-child(2),.plans.reveal.in .plan:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.11s}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(3),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(3),.g3.reveal.in .tcard:nth-child(3),.plans.reveal.in .plan:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.19s}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(4),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.27s}
  .mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.35s}
  @keyframes pop-in{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px) scale(.96);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1);} }

  /* ---------- SCROLL PROGRESS BAR ---------- */
  .scroll-progress{ position:fixed; top:0; left:0; height:3px; width:0%; z-index:100;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue),var(--brand-cyan)); transition:width .08s linear; }

  /* ---------- CURSOR SPOTLIGHT (hero) ---------- */
  .hero{ position:relative; }
  .hero::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0;
    background:radial-gradient(480px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,20%), rgba(44,95,221,.10), transparent 60%);
    transition:background .05s linear;
  }
  .hero .wrap{ position:relative; z-index:1; }

  /* ---------- TILT / MAGNETIC CARDS ---------- */
  .tilt{ transform-style:preserve-3d; will-change:transform; transition:transform .12s ease-out, box-shadow .25s ease; }
  .mcard.tilt:hover, .wcard.tilt:hover, .tcard.tilt:hover, .plan.tilt:hover{ box-shadow:var(--sh-lg); }
  .tilt-glow{
    position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
    background:radial-gradient(220px circle at var(--gx,50%) var(--gy,50%), rgba(44,95,221,.14), transparent 65%);
    transition:opacity .25s ease; z-index:0;
  }
  .tilt:hover .tilt-glow{ opacity:1; }
  .mcard, .wcard, .tcard{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .plan{ position:relative; overflow:visible; }
  .mcard > *:not(.tilt-glow), .wcard > *:not(.tilt-glow), .tcard > *:not(.tilt-glow), .plan > *:not(.tilt-glow):not(.flag){ position:relative; z-index:1; }
  .plan .flag{ z-index:2; }

  /* ---------- MAGNETIC BUTTONS ---------- */
  .btn{ position:relative; will-change:transform; }

  /* ---------- ORBIT INTERACTIVITY ---------- */
  .ring{ animation:spin-slow 90s linear infinite; }
  .ring.r2{ animation:spin-slow-rev 70s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes spin-slow{ from{transform:rotate(0deg);} to{transform:rotate(360deg);} }
  @keyframes spin-slow-rev{ from{transform:rotate(0deg);} to{transform:rotate(-360deg);} }
  .onode{ cursor:pointer; transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; }
  .onode:hover{ transform:scale(1.22) !important; box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(44,95,221,.22); border-color:var(--teal); z-index:5; }
  .onode:active{ transform:scale(1.05) !important; }
  .core{ animation:core-pulse 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; cursor:pointer; }
  @keyframes core-pulse{ 0%,100%{ transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);} 50%{ transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.04);} }
  .olabel{ transition:opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease; }
  .onode:hover ~ .olabel, .olabel:hover{ opacity:1; }

  /* ---------- STAT COUNT-UP ---------- */
  .stripe .it{ transition:transform .3s ease; }
  .stripe.counted .it{ animation:stat-pop .5s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.2) backwards; }
  .stripe .it:nth-child(1){ animation-delay:.05s } .stripe .it:nth-child(2){ animation-delay:.15s }
  .stripe .it:nth-child(3){ animation-delay:.25s } .stripe .it:nth-child(4){ animation-delay:.35s }
  @keyframes stat-pop{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px) scale(.9);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1);} }

  /* ---------- NAV SHRINK ON SCROLL ---------- */
  header{ transition:box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease; }
  header.scrolled{ box-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(44,95,221,.08); }
  header.scrolled .navbar{ padding-top:9px; padding-bottom:9px; }
  .navbar{ transition:padding .2s ease; }

  /* ---------- MODULE ICON MICRO-INTERACTION ---------- */
  .mic{ transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .25s ease; }
  .mcard:hover .mic{ transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.1); }
  .mcard{ transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; }
  .mcard:hover{ border-color:rgba(0,176,214,.35); }
  .mcard li{ transition:transform .18s ease, color .18s ease; }
  .mcard:hover li{ color:var(--ink); }

  /* ---------- FAQ ICON ROTATE ---------- */
  .fq::after{ transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), color .2s ease; display:inline-block; }
  .fitem.open .fq::after{ content:"+"; transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); color:var(--coral); }
  .fq{ transition:color .2s ease; }
  .fq:hover{ color:var(--teal-deep); }

  /* ---------- COMPARISON TABLE ROW HOVER ---------- */
  table.cmp tbody tr:not(.cta-row){ transition:background .15s ease; }
  table.cmp tbody tr:not(.cta-row):hover{ background:#f2f5fb; }
  table.cmp tbody tr:not(.cta-row):hover td.f{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; }
  table.cmp tbody tr:not(.cta-row):hover td.hl{ background:rgba(44,95,221,.07); }

  /* ---------- PLAN "MOST CHOSEN" SHINE ---------- */
  .plan.best{ position:relative; }
  .plan.best::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; top:0; left:-60%; width:40%; height:100%;
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.5), transparent);
    transform:skewX(-20deg); animation:shine 4.5s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events:none;
  }
  @keyframes shine{ 0%,20%{ left:-60%; } 45%,100%{ left:130%; } }

  /* ---------- WHY CARD ICON NUMBER FLOURISH ---------- */
  .wcard{ transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; }
  .wcard:hover{ border-color:rgba(0,176,214,.35); }
  .wcard .n{ transition:transform .25s ease, color .25s ease; display:inline-block; }
  .wcard:hover .n{ transform:scale(1.15) translateY(-2px); color:var(--teal); }

  /* ---------- SIGNATURE CARD HOVER LIFT ---------- */
  .rep, .card-w, .chat{ transition:transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease; }
  .rep:hover, .card-w:hover, .chat:hover{ transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 28px 60px rgba(44,95,221,.16); }

  /* ---------- LIVE ACTIVITY TICKER ---------- */
  .ticker-band{ background:var(--brand-blue-deep); overflow:hidden; padding:14px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
  .ticker-track{ display:flex; gap:0; width:max-content; animation:ticker-scroll 32s linear infinite; }
  .ticker-band:hover .ticker-track{ animation-play-state:paused; }
  .ticker-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:0 34px; font-size:13px; color:#C6D3E6; white-space:nowrap; border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
  .ticker-item .dot{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); flex-shrink:0; }
  .ticker-item b{ color:#fff; font-weight:600; }
  @keyframes ticker-scroll{ from{ transform:translateX(0); } to{ transform:translateX(-50%); } }

  /* ---------- EXPOSURE QUIZ (interactive) ---------- */
  .quiz-band{ background:linear-gradient(155deg,var(--brand-blue-deep) 0%, #2c5fdd 55%, var(--brand-cyan) 140%); position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .quiz-band::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:.55; pointer-events:none;
    background:radial-gradient(600px circle at 12% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.12), transparent 55%),
               radial-gradient(520px circle at 88% 82%, rgba(0,176,214,.28), transparent 55%);
  }
  .quiz-inner{ position:relative; z-index:1; }
  .quiz-head{ text-align:center; max-width:720px; margin:0 auto 48px; }
  .quiz-head .eyebrow{ color:#b8e9f7; justify-content:center; }
  .quiz-head .eyebrow::before{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,var(--brand-cyan)); }
  .quiz-head h2{ color:#fff; font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px); margin-bottom:14px; }
  .quiz-head .qsub{ color:rgba(255,255,255,.78); font-size:16px; margin:0 auto; max-width:580px; line-height:1.55; }
  .quiz-body{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.08fr); gap:40px; align-items:stretch; }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .quiz-body{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:28px; } .quiz-visual{ min-height:220px; max-height:280px; } }
  .quiz-visual{ position:relative; border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; min-height:420px; box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(17,24,38,.22); background:#1a2a6c; }
  .quiz-visual img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; position:absolute; inset:0; transition:opacity .35s ease, transform .45s ease; }
  .quiz-visual img.is-swap{ opacity:0; transform:scale(1.04); }
  .quiz-visual::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 35%,rgba(17,24,38,.78) 100%); pointer-events:none; }
  .quiz-visual-cap{ position:absolute; left:22px; right:22px; bottom:22px; z-index:1; color:#fff; }
  .quiz-visual-cap strong{ display:block; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px; }
  .quiz-visual-cap span{ font-size:13px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.78); line-height:1.45; }
  .quiz-card{ background:#fff; border-radius:20px; padding:28px 30px; box-shadow:var(--sh-lg); min-height:420px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
  .quiz-meta{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .quiz-count{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--mute); letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; }
  .quiz-progress{ display:flex; gap:5px; flex:1; max-width:220px; margin-left:auto; }
  .quiz-progress i{ flex:1; height:4px; border-radius:100px; background:var(--paper-2); }
  .quiz-progress i.done{ background:var(--brand-cyan); }
  .quiz-step{ display:none; flex:1; flex-direction:column; }
  .quiz-step.active{ display:flex; animation:qstep-in .35s ease; }
  @keyframes qstep-in{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateX(14px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateX(0);} }
  .quiz-step h3{ font-size:clamp(17px,2.2vw,20px); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:18px; line-height:1.3; }
  .quiz-opts{ display:grid; gap:10px; }
  .quiz-opt{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; text-align:center; padding:14px 16px; border-radius:12px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); background:var(--paper); font-size:14.2px; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.35; transition:border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease, transform .15s ease; }
  .quiz-opt:hover{ border-color:var(--brand-blue); background:#eaf0ff; transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .quiz-opt.picked{ border-color:var(--brand-blue); background:#eaf0ff; font-weight:600; }
  .quiz-opt .qico{ width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:10px; background:#eaf0ff; color:var(--brand-blue); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; }
  .quiz-opt .qico svg{ width:18px; height:18px; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
  .quiz-opt.picked .qico{ background:var(--brand-blue); color:#fff; }
  .quiz-opt > span:last-child{ text-align:left; }
  .quiz-result{ display:none; flex:1; flex-direction:column; animation:qstep-in .4s ease; }
  .quiz-result.active{ display:flex; }
  .quiz-score-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .quiz-score{ font-family:'Inter'; font-weight:700; font-size:42px; line-height:1; background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--coral),var(--brand-blue-deep)); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; }
  .quiz-score-label{ font-size:13px; color:var(--mute); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; font-weight:600; }
  .quiz-result > p{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14.5px; margin:0 0 18px; line-height:1.5; }
  .quiz-checks{ list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0 0 20px; display:grid; gap:8px; }
  .quiz-checks li{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; font-size:13.4px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.4; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--paper-2); }
  .quiz-checks li b{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; display:block; margin-bottom:1px; }
  .quiz-checks .qico{ width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:var(--brand-blue); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; border:1px solid var(--line); }
  .quiz-checks .qico svg{ width:15px; height:15px; }
  .quiz-lock{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--mute); margin:0 0 16px; }
  .quiz-result .cta-btns{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-top:auto; }
  .quiz-result .cta-btns .btn{ width:100%; max-width:280px; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; }
  .quiz-restart{ font-size:13px; color:var(--teal-deep); font-weight:600; margin-top:14px; align-self:center; background:none; border:none; padding:0; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .ring, .ring.r2, .core, .plan.best::after, .ticker-track{ animation:none !important; }
    .quiz-visual img{ transition:none; }
  }

  /* —— Final CTA photo —— */
  .final.has-photo{
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(55,56,172,.92),rgba(44,95,221,.88) 55%,rgba(0,176,214,.82) 130%),
      url('/images/family.jpg');
    background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  }

</style>
</head>

<section class="quiz-band" id="check">
  <div class="wrap quiz-inner reveal">
    <div class="quiz-head">
      <span class="eyebrow">60-second check</span>
      <h2>How exposed are you right now?</h2>
      <p class="qsub">Six curiosity questions — no login, no documents yet. Answer honestly, see your gaps, then unlock a SurakshaOne check on PAN, Aadhaar, mobile, email and more.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="quiz-body">
      <aside class="quiz-visual" aria-hidden="true">
        <img id="quizVisual" src="/images/cyber.jpg" alt="">
        <div class="quiz-visual-cap">
          <strong id="quizVisualTitle">Identity on the open web</strong>
          <span id="quizVisualSub">PAN, Aadhaar and mobile numbers show up in places most people never look.</span>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <div class="quiz-card">
        <div class="quiz-meta">
          <span class="quiz-count" id="quizCount">Question 1 of 6</span>
          <div class="quiz-progress" id="quizProgress"><i class="done"></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
        </div>

        <div class="quiz-step active" data-step="1" data-img="/images/cyber.jpg" data-title="Identity on the open web" data-sub="PAN, Aadhaar and mobile numbers show up in places most people never look.">
          <h3>Have you checked if your PAN, Aadhaar or mobile number appears online?</h3>
          <div class="quiz-opts">
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="2"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l18 18"/><path d="M10.6 10.6a2 2 0 0 0 2.8 2.8"/><path d="M9.9 5.1A9.8 9.8 0 0 1 12 5c5 0 8.5 4.5 9.5 7-.4 1-1.2 2.4-2.4 3.6"/><path d="M6.1 6.1C4.6 7.4 3.5 9 2.5 12c1 2.5 4.5 7 9.5 7 1.2 0 2.3-.2 3.3-.6"/></svg></span><span>No — I've never checked</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="1"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></span><span>Once, a while back</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="0"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l7 3v5c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 9-4-1.5-7-4.5-7-9V6l7-3z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg></span><span>Yes — I monitor this</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="quiz-step" data-step="2" data-img="/images/solo-phone.jpg" data-title="Your number, other people's hands" data-sub="SIM swaps, fake KYC and spam registrations often start with a leaked mobile number.">
          <h3>Would you know if your phone number was registered on apps or loans you never signed up for?</h3>
          <div class="quiz-opts">
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="2"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l18 18"/><path d="M10.6 10.6a2 2 0 0 0 2.8 2.8"/><path d="M9.9 5.1A9.8 9.8 0 0 1 12 5c5 0 8.5 4.5 9.5 7-.4 1-1.2 2.4-2.4 3.6"/><path d="M6.1 6.1C4.6 7.4 3.5 9 2.5 12c1 2.5 4.5 7 9.5 7 1.2 0 2.3-.2 3.3-.6"/></svg></span><span>No idea — I wouldn't catch it</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="1"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></span><span>Only if something bounced back</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="0"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l7 3v5c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 9-4-1.5-7-4.5-7-9V6l7-3z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg></span><span>Yes — I audit registrations</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="quiz-step" data-step="3" data-img="/images/parents.jpg" data-title="Parents get the hardest calls" data-sub="Elders are targeted first — and they rarely have a safe way to verify a stranger on the line.">
          <h3>Do your parents have their own way to verify a suspicious call?</h3>
          <div class="quiz-opts">
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="2"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l18 18"/><path d="M10.6 10.6a2 2 0 0 0 2.8 2.8"/><path d="M9.9 5.1A9.8 9.8 0 0 1 12 5c5 0 8.5 4.5 9.5 7-.4 1-1.2 2.4-2.4 3.6"/><path d="M6.1 6.1C4.6 7.4 3.5 9 2.5 12c1 2.5 4.5 7 9.5 7 1.2 0 2.3-.2 3.3-.6"/></svg></span><span>No — they'd probably believe it</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="1"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></span><span>They'd usually call me first</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="0"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l7 3v5c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 9-4-1.5-7-4.5-7-9V6l7-3z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg></span><span>Yes — they have a clear check</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="quiz-step" data-step="4" data-img="/images/life.jpg" data-title="Accounts your family can't find" data-sub="When something happens to you, nominees and documents are useless if nobody knows where they are.">
          <h3>If something happened to you tomorrow, could your family find your accounts and nominees?</h3>
          <div class="quiz-opts">
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="2"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l18 18"/><path d="M10.6 10.6a2 2 0 0 0 2.8 2.8"/><path d="M9.9 5.1A9.8 9.8 0 0 1 12 5c5 0 8.5 4.5 9.5 7-.4 1-1.2 2.4-2.4 3.6"/><path d="M6.1 6.1C4.6 7.4 3.5 9 2.5 12c1 2.5 4.5 7 9.5 7 1.2 0 2.3-.2 3.3-.6"/></svg></span><span>No — nothing is written down</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="1"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></span><span>Partially — some of it</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="0"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l7 3v5c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 9-4-1.5-7-4.5-7-9V6l7-3z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg></span><span>Yes — documented and reachable</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="quiz-step" data-step="5" data-img="/images/family-home.jpg" data-title="Loans you never took" data-sub="Fraudulent credit and soft pulls often surface only after the damage is done.">
          <h3>Would you know if a loan or credit line was opened in your name without you?</h3>
          <div class="quiz-opts">
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="2"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l18 18"/><path d="M10.6 10.6a2 2 0 0 0 2.8 2.8"/><path d="M9.9 5.1A9.8 9.8 0 0 1 12 5c5 0 8.5 4.5 9.5 7-.4 1-1.2 2.4-2.4 3.6"/><path d="M6.1 6.1C4.6 7.4 3.5 9 2.5 12c1 2.5 4.5 7 9.5 7 1.2 0 2.3-.2 3.3-.6"/></svg></span><span>No — I don't check credit</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="1"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></span><span>Maybe once a year</span></button>
            <button class="quiz-opt" data-val="0"><span class="qico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l7 3v5c0 4.5-3 7.5-7 9-4-1.5-7-4.5-7-9V6l7-3z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg></span><span>Yes — I watch for this</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="quiz-step" data-step="6" data-img="/images/download-phone.jpg" data-title="Emails working without you" data-sub="Reset links, KYC OTPs and account takeovers often start with an inbox you no longer watch closely.">
          <h3>Do you know where your email IDs are still being used — without your knowledge?</h3>
          <div class="quiz-opts">

<section id="faq">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head center reveal"><span class="eyebrow">Questions</span><h2>Straight answers</h2></div>
    <div class="faq reveal">
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">What exactly am I buying?</button><div class="fa"><p>A membership covering five everyday services: doctor and dietician consultations, identity exposure monitoring, travel assistance, household financial readiness tools, and a dedicated care line for your parents. One subscription, one dashboard, one renewal date.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">How does the identity exposure report work?</button><div class="fa"><p>You tell us which identifiers to check — PAN, Aadhaar, passport, addresses, email accounts. We check them against known breach and leak databases and return a report showing which are already circulating, with a specific action for each exposure. After that, you're alerted whenever your details surface in a new breach.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">What can I actually do if my details are already out there?</button><div class="fa"><p>More than most people assume, and the report tells you what. If your PAN shows up, pull your credit report and check for loans you didn't take — people typically find these years late, once the damage to their record is done. If a password is exposed, you'll be told which account and what to change. Every exposure comes with its own next step.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">What does the nutrition side actually include?</button><div class="fa"><p>A consultation with a qualified dietician and a diet chart built around what you actually eat — your kitchen, your budget, your region — rather than a template. If your circumstances change, so does the chart. It supports your care alongside medical treatment; it does not replace your doctor or your prescription.</p></div></div>
        <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">Are consultations really unlimited?</button><div class="fa"><p>GP and mental health tele-consultations are unlimited across all plans, for every covered member.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">How does ParentCare work if my parents aren't comfortable with apps?</button><div class="fa"><p>They don't need to be. ParentCare works on a phone number they call, with support in the language they speak. The app side is for you — you see when they've used it and what happened. They control what gets shared.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">Is there a waiting period?</button><div class="fa"><p>No. Everything is live from the day you join — your exposure report generates immediately and consultations are available the same day.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">What isn't included?</button><div class="fa"><p>We coordinate and advise; we don't replace hospitals or banks. Specifically: no in-person medical treatment or hospitalisation costs, no recovery of money already lost to fraud (we help you report it correctly and fast, which is what actually improves the odds), and no investment or tax advice. Nutrition guidance supports your care, it does not replace medical treatment or prescriptions.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">Can I cancel?</button><div class="fa"><p>Anytime, from the dashboard. If you cancel within 14 days and haven't used a service, you get a full refund. After that, cancellation stops the next renewal.</p></div></div>
      <div class="fitem"><button class="fq">What happens to my data if I leave?</button><div class="fa"><p>Ask us to erase your stored identifiers and we delete them, then confirm in writing. Your data isn't retained to market to you afterwards.</p></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
  var navToggle=document.getElementById('navToggle'),navLinks=document.getElementById('navLinks'),ddProt=document.getElementById('ddProt');
  navToggle.addEventListener('click',function(){var o=navLinks.classList.toggle('open');navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o)});
  navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(a.parentElement===ddProt&&window.innerWidth<=960)return;
    navLinks.classList.remove('open');navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');ddProt.classList.remove('open');
  })});
  ddProt.querySelector('a').addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(window.innerWidth<=960){e.preventDefault();ddProt.classList.toggle('open')}
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.stab').forEach(function(t){t.addEventListener('click',function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.stab').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected','false')});
    t.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
    document.querySelectorAll('.spanel').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active')});
    document.getElementById('s-'+t.dataset.s).classList.add('active');
  })});

  document.querySelectorAll('.fq').forEach(function(q){q.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var i=q.parentElement,was=i.classList.contains('open');
    document.querySelectorAll('.fitem').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('open')});
    if(!was)i.classList.add('open');
  })});

  var tgA=document.getElementById('tgAnnual'),tgM=document.getElementById('tgMonthly');
  function setBilling(annual){
    tgA.classList.toggle('on',annual);tgM.classList.toggle('on',!annual);
    document.querySelectorAll('.plan .amt,.plan .per').forEach(function(el){
      el.textContent=annual?el.dataset.a:el.dataset.m;
    });
  }
  tgA.addEventListener('click',function(){setBilling(true)});
  tgM.addEventListener('click',function(){setBilling(false)});

  var rev=document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(en){if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(en.target)}})},{threshold:.1,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
    rev.forEach(function(el){io.observe(el)});
  } else rev.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in')});

  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  // Scroll progress bar
  var progressBar = document.getElementById('scrollProgress');
  function updateProgress(){
    var h = document.documentElement;
    var pct = (h.scrollTop) / (h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight) * 100;
    progressBar.style.width = (pct||0) + '%';
  }
  document.addEventListener('scroll', updateProgress, {passive:true});
  updateProgress();

  // Nav shrink on scroll
  var headerEl = document.querySelector('header');
  function updateHeader(){ headerEl.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 12); }
  document.addEventListener('scroll', updateHeader, {passive:true});
  updateHeader();

  // Stat pop animation once in view
  var stripeEl = document.querySelector('.stripe');
  if (stripeEl && 'IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var stripeIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(en){ if(en.isIntersecting){ stripeEl.classList.add('counted'); stripeIO.disconnect(); } }); }, {threshold:.3});
    stripeIO.observe(stripeEl);
  } else if (stripeEl) stripeEl.classList.add('counted');

  // Cursor spotlight in hero
  var heroEl = document.querySelector('.hero');
  if (heroEl && !reduceMotion){
    heroEl.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
      var r = heroEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      heroEl.style.setProperty('--mx', (e.clientX - r.left) + 'px');
      heroEl.style.setProperty('--my', (e.clientY - r.top) + 'px');
    });
  }

  // Tilt + glow on cards
  if (!reduceMotion) {
    var tiltTargets = document.querySelectorAll('.mcard, .wcard, .tcard, .plan');
    tiltTargets.forEach(function(card){
      card.classList.add('tilt');
      var glow = document.createElement('div');
      glow.className = 'tilt-glow';
      card.insertBefore(glow, card.firstChild);
      card.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
        var r = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        var x = e.clientX - r.left, y = e.clientY - r.top;
        var cx = r.width/2, cy = r.height/2;
        var rx = ((y - cy) / cy) * -4;
        var ry = ((x - cx) / cx) * 4;
        card.style.transform = 'perspective(700px) rotateX(' + rx + 'deg) rotateY(' + ry + 'deg) translateY(-3px)';
        card.style.setProperty('--gx', x + 'px');
        card.style.setProperty('--gy', y + 'px');
      });
      card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ card.style.transform = ''; });
    });

    // Magnetic buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('.btn-p, .btn-g').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
        var r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        var x = e.clientX - r.left - r.width/2, y = e.clientY - r.top - r.height/2;
        btn.style.transform = 'translate(' + (x*0.18) + 'px,' + (y*0.35) + 'px)';
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ btn.style.transform = ''; });
    });
  }

  // Orbit node click -> smooth scroll to module (anchors already handle this via href)
  document.querySelectorAll('.onode').forEach(function(n){
    n.style.pointerEvents='auto';
  });

  // Live activity ticker (labeled as illustrative; not real user data)
  var tickerItems = [
    'CyberSafe exposure check run · Bengaluru',
    'GP consultation completed · Pune',
    'Suspicious message flagged as scam · Delhi NCR',
    'Travel assistance request · Mumbai',
    'Parent care line used · Lucknow',
    'Nominee checklist updated · Chennai',
    'Diet chart reviewed · Hyderabad',
    'Travel hotline connected · Jaipur'
  ];
  var track = document.getElementById('tickerTrack');
  if (track) {
    var html = '';
    (tickerItems.concat(tickerItems)).forEach(function(t){
      html += '<div class="ticker-item"><span class="dot"></span><span><b>Illustrative</b> — ' + t + '</span></div>';
    });
    track.innerHTML = html;
  }

  // Exposure quiz — 6 hooks → check-as-a-service CTA
  (function(){
    var steps = document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-step');
    var progressDots = document.querySelectorAll('#quizProgress i');
    var resultEl = document.getElementById('quizResult');
    var scoreEl = document.getElementById('quizScore');
    var scoreLabelEl = document.getElementById('quizScoreLabel');
    var msgEl = document.getElementById('quizMsg');
    var countEl = document.getElementById('quizCount');
    var visual = document.getElementById('quizVisual');
    var visualTitle = document.getElementById('quizVisualTitle');
    var visualSub = document.getElementById('quizVisualSub');
    var restartBtn = document.getElementById('quizRestart');
    var current = 0;
    var total = 0;
    var maxScore = steps.length * 2;

    function syncVisual(stepEl){
      if (!stepEl || !visual) return;
      var next = stepEl.getAttribute('data-img');
      var title = stepEl.getAttribute('data-title') || '';
      var sub = stepEl.getAttribute('data-sub') || '';
      if (visualTitle) visualTitle.textContent = title;
      if (visualSub) visualSub.textContent = sub;
      if (next && visual.getAttribute('src') !== next){
        visual.classList.add('is-swap');
        setTimeout(function(){
          visual.setAttribute('src', next);
          visual.classList.remove('is-swap');
        }, 180);
      }
    }

    function showStep(idx){
      steps.forEach(function(s,i){ s.classList.toggle('active', i===idx); });
      progressDots.forEach(function(d,i){ d.classList.toggle('done', i<=idx); });
      resultEl.classList.remove('active');
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = 'Question ' + (idx + 1) + ' of ' + steps.length;
      syncVisual(steps[idx]);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-opt').forEach(function(opt){
      opt.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var stepEl = opt.closest('.quiz-step');
        stepEl.querySelectorAll('.quiz-opt').forEach(function(o){ o.classList.remove('picked'); });
        opt.classList.add('picked');
        total += parseInt(opt.dataset.val, 10);
        setTimeout(function(){
          if (current < steps.length - 1){
            current++;
            showStep(current);
          } else {
            progressDots.forEach(function(d){ d.classList.add('done'); });
            steps.forEach(function(s){ s.classList.remove('active'); });
            resultEl.classList.add('active');
            if (countEl) countEl.textContent = 'Your snapshot';
            if (visualTitle) visualTitle.textContent = 'Checks unlock with a plan';
            if (visualSub) visualSub.textContent = 'Subscribe to run PAN, Aadhaar, mobile and email checks — and see the details behind your gaps.';
            if (visual){
              visual.classList.add('is-swap');
              setTimeout(function(){
                visual.setAttribute('src', '/images/protection-hero.jpg');
                visual.classList.remove('is-swap');
              }, 180);
            }
            var pct = Math.round((total / maxScore) * 100);
            scoreEl.textContent = pct + '%';
            if (pct >= 65){
              scoreLabelEl.textContent = 'High exposure';
              msgEl.textContent = "Several gaps are open — identity visibility, family readiness, or credit you wouldn't spot alone. A SurakshaOne check is built for exactly this.";
            } else if (pct >= 30){
              scoreLabelEl.textContent = 'Partial exposure';
              msgEl.textContent = "You've covered some basics, but enough unknowns remain that a member check on PAN, mobile or email is worth running.";
            } else {
              scoreLabelEl.textContent = 'Low exposure';
              msgEl.textContent = "You're ahead of most people — still worth a periodic check so parents, loans and old email registrations don't drift.";
            }
          }
        }, 260);
      });
    });

    restartBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      current = 0; total = 0;
      document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-opt').forEach(function(o){ o.classList.remove('picked'); });
      showStep(0);
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
